alternatives.name: fixed-flat-semantic-catalog
alternatives.measured_output: 41 logits = 164 bytes; 41-byte mask; O(41) decode and masking
alternatives.rationale: The fixed scenario roles and direct entity slots express every V1 bus operation with stable native, ONNX, and in-game indices.

alternatives.name: tile-expanded-flat-catalog
alternatives.measured_output: approximately 13269 logits = 53076 bytes before probabilities or gradients
alternatives.rationale: Expanding every tile and orientation wastes more than 99 percent of policy outputs on planner-ineligible actions in the frozen 32 by 32 corpus.

alternatives.name: dynamic-candidate-table
alternatives.measured_output: bounded table requires candidate features and state-dependent row meanings
alternatives.rationale: A changing candidate row would need a new observation input and scorer contract; M04 intentionally froze no candidate feature tensor.

town.deletion: slot becomes absent and every referencing action is masked
town.reuse: same direct ID replaces the slot only after reset or engine reuse
town.overflow: M02 scope validator rejects more than two towns

vehicle.deletion: slot becomes absent and route/start/stop actions are masked
vehicle.reuse: same direct ID names the replacement primary company bus
vehicle.overflow: purchase is masked at eight primary company road vehicles

station_site.deletion: site becomes buildable again only if normal native validation accepts it
station_site.reuse: station ID is resolved from the authoritative tile at every boundary
station_site.overflow: only the two reviewed passenger catchment sites are agent-reachable

depot_site.deletion: excluded V1 removal means deletion is not agent-reachable
depot_site.reuse: depot association is resolved from the authoritative planned tile
depot_site.overflow: exactly one reviewed depot site is agent-reachable

families.name: WAIT
families.cheap_mask: always legal at an active non-truncated AT_BOUNDARY
families.complete_legality: no engine command; lifecycle and horizon are the complete legality check
families.success_mutation: no command mutation; ordinary simulation may evolve during the 128 ticks
families.log_encoding: index 0 family WAIT status NO_OP and an empty native command list

families.name: SELECT_TOWNS
families.cheap_mask: both direct town slots exist, differ, and are not already the selected ordered pair
families.complete_legality: authoritative Town pool identity check after decode
families.success_mutation: bridge-owned causal endpoint selection changes; OpenTTD engine state does not
families.log_encoding: ordered origin and destination direct town slots

families.name: BUILD_ROAD_CONNECTOR
families.cheap_mask: planned connector is absent and no road depot occupies its end tile
families.complete_legality: CMD_BUILD_LONG_ROAD test mode with ROADTYPE_ROAD, full endpoints, fail-on-obstacle AI semantics
families.cost_semantics: exact OpenTTD construction cost debited once by the command wrapper
families.success_mutation: native road bits connect the frozen route front to the depot site; the pre-existing route tile retains its authoritative owner and the new endpoint is company-owned
families.transaction: one top-level native command; OpenTTD command semantics are authoritative
families.log_encoding: resolved start/end tile, axis, native cost, and error IDs

families.name: BUILD_BUS_STOP
families.cheap_mask: site is empty and orientation equals the reviewed inward route entrance
families.complete_legality: CMD_BUILD_ROAD_STOP test mode for one bay passenger stop on ROADTYPE_ROAD
families.cost_semantics: exact OpenTTD station construction cost debited by the command wrapper
families.success_mutation: owned bus station appears at the resolved tile with the decoded orientation
families.log_encoding: town slot, resolved tile, orientation, created station identity through post-state

families.name: BUILD_ROAD_DEPOT
families.cheap_mask: connector exists, depot site is empty, and orientation equals the reviewed route entrance
families.cost_semantics: exact OpenTTD depot construction cost debited by the command wrapper
families.success_mutation: owned road depot replaces the connector end tile and faces the route
families.log_encoding: resolved tile, orientation, native cost, and post-state depot identity

families.name: BUY_BUS
families.cheap_mask: owned planned depot exists and fewer than eight primary company road vehicles exist
families.complete_legality: CMD_BUILD_VEHICLE test mode with fixed engine, passenger refit, and authoritative affordability
families.cost_semantics: exact OpenTTD vehicle purchase/refit cost debited by the command wrapper
families.success_mutation: next free direct VehicleID slot contains a stopped 31-passenger MPS Regal Bus in depot
families.log_encoding: depot tile, engine ID, cost, and created vehicle identity through post-state

families.name: ASSIGN_ROUTE
families.cheap_mask: vehicle and both selected endpoint stations exist, endpoints differ, and route is not already identical
families.complete_legality: ownership plus independent CMD_INSERT_ORDER test calls for both station orders
families.cost_semantics: all order commands have zero OpenTTD money cost
families.success_mutation: vehicle has exactly the ordered origin and destination station orders
families.transaction: snapshot prior orders, replace, and fully restore prior orders on any failed prefix; rollback failure is fatal integration failure
families.log_encoding: every execute and rollback subcommand is ordered with phase, cost, error IDs, and rolled_back flag

families.name: SET_RUNNING
families.cheap_mask: owned primary road vehicle is stopped and has exactly two manual orders
families.complete_legality: CMD_START_STOP_VEHICLE test mode against the current vehicle state
families.success_mutation: vehicle is running before the first advanced tick
families.log_encoding: vehicle slot, desired state, native result, and post-state

families.name: SET_STOPPED
families.cheap_mask: owned primary road vehicle is currently running
families.complete_legality: CMD_START_STOP_VEHICLE test mode against the current vehicle state
families.success_mutation: vehicle is stopped before the first advanced tick
families.log_encoding: vehicle slot, desired state, native result, and post-state

dispositions.rationale: The eight-bus cap and 512-action horizon do not require selling; exclusion avoids destructive value loops before M06 reward exploit tests exist.
The frozen templates need one route, two stops, and one depot; removal adds ownership and destructive-loop surface without being needed for V1 acceptance.
The frozen company starts with sufficient balance and loan; explicit loan actions would permit oscillation and are unnecessary for the bounded V1 route task.

outcomes.name: SUCCESS
outcomes.meaning: A legal action completed and the fixed simulation interval advanced.

outcomes.name: NO_OP
outcomes.meaning: WAIT completed and only ordinary simulation evolution occurred.

outcomes.name: STALE_REJECTED
outcomes.meaning: The handle, boundary, transition, or issued mask token no longer names the current state.

outcomes.name: ILLEGAL_INPUT
outcomes.meaning: The index, encoding, or current mask membership is invalid and indicates a policy/runtime defect.

outcomes.name: NATIVE_REJECTED
outcomes.meaning: Native validation or execution rejected an apparently legal action; the attempt consumes one decision interval.

outcomes.name: INTEGRATION_FAILURE
outcomes.mutation: untrusted process state; worker enters FAILED
outcomes.meaning: An invariant, rollback, bridge, I/O, crash, or internal failure invalidated the worker.
